query: What anonymization thresholds, local partner review steps, and dissemination safeguards are recommended for sensitive caregiver data in small Thai communities?

response.query: What anonymization thresholds, local partner review steps, and dissemination safeguards are recommended for sensitive caregiver data in small Thai communities?
response.answer: Anonymization thresholds for sensitive caregiver data in small Thai communities include removing direct identifiers. Local partner review steps involve ethical oversight and compliance checks. Dissemination safeguards include restricted access and data encryption.

results.title: JMIR Cancer - Evaluating Online Cannabis Health Information for Thai Breast Cancer Survivors Using the Quality Evaluation Scoring Tool (QUEST): Mixed Method Study
results.content: Evaluating Online Cannabis Health Information for Thai Breast Cancer Survivors Using the Quality Evaluation Scoring Tool (QUEST): Mixed Method Study: Mixed Method Study"). Background: Following medical cannabis legalization in Thailand in 2019, more people are seeking medical cannabis–related information, including women living with breast cancer. The extent to which they access cannabis-related information from internet sources and social media platforms and the quality of such content are relatively unknown and need further evaluation. Objective: This study aims to analyze the factors determining cannabis-related content quality for breast cancer care from internet sources and on social media platforms and examine the characteristics of such content accessed and consumed by Thai breast cancer survivors. The group identified medical cannabis–related content from frequently accessed internet sources and social media platforms. Conclusions: The varying quality of medical cannabis–related information on internet sources and social media platforms accessed and shared by Thai breast cancer survivors is an issue of concern.

results.title: 'AI For Social Good: Strengthening Capabilities and Government Frameworks in Asia and the Pacific’ informing AI Policies and Strategies in Thailand - APRU
results.content: 'AI For Social Good: Strengthening Capabilities and Government Frameworks in Asia and the Pacific’ informing AI Policies and Strategies in Thailand. In response to this development the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UN ESCAP) and APRU, with funding from Google.org, developed the ‘AI for Social Good’ multi-stakeholder network. The network has been supporting policy makers by developing insights on what capabilities and governance frameworks will be most supportive for leveraging AI effectively for social good. The ‘**Strengthening Capabilities and Government Frameworks in Asia and the Pacific**’ project is building on these past activities to achieve transformative impact by bringing together government agencies from the Asia-Pacific region and outstanding researchers to:. In collaboration with the Thai Office of National Higher Education, Science Research and Innovation Policy, scholars in AI related research will be conducting research to support the Thai Government in the development of policies promoting and enabling AI policy frameworks and building AI capabilities for social good in the following focus areas:.
